profile.name: Victor Immanuel Sunarko
profile.bio: 📷 Visual Storytelling · Finding stories in ordinary moments

reels.title: A Place Called Home
reels.lensSpecs: Sony Lens 4x Optical · Natural Light · Digicam Texture
reels.credits: Shot on Sony DSC-W310 in Kediri
reels.quote: Some places don't need to be remembered. They simply remain, waiting for you to come home.
reels.fullCaption:
A Place Called Home

Some places don't need to be remembered
They simply remain, waiting for you to come home.

A quiet corner of home —
where the air feels softer,
the trees grow freely,
and time somehow moves a little slower.

Kediri — September 12, 2026.

Shot on an old digicam — some places simply don't need 4K.

reels.title: ☕ Seduh
reels.lensSpecs: 35mm Prime · Steam & Ambient Tungsten · Coffee Narrative
reels.quote: Some stories don't need words. They unfold slowly, one frame at a time. Water meets coffee. Steam rises. Time passes.
reels.fullCaption:
☕ Seduh

Some stories don't need words.
They unfold slowly, one frame at a time.

Water meets coffee.
Steam rises.
Time passes.

A simple ritual, quietly turned into a story.

Talent: @pasanko.si
Videographer: @victr.is
Gaffer: @cmul.fp

stills.title: Quietly There
stills.quote: Sometimes peace isn't found. It's simply noticed. A building behind the trees, a quiet afternoon.
stills.fullCaption:
Quietly There

Sometimes peace isn't found. It's simply noticed.

A building behind the trees,
a quiet afternoon,
and nothing particularly extraordinary.

Maybe that's the point.

Not every peaceful moment announces itself. Sometimes, you simply have to notice that it was already there.

stills.title: Momentary
stills.quote: Some moments are not meant to be captured perfectly. Only quietly witnessed. For a second, the world felt still.
stills.fullCaption:
Momentary

Some moments are not meant to be captured perfectly.
Only quietly witnessed.

A sleeping cat, seen through the leaves — unaware of the camera, unaware of the moment.

For a second, the world felt still.

stills.title: Lustrous Flower
stills.quote: A little light can change the way something ordinary is seen. Somewhere between what is there and what the light reveals.
stills.fullCaption:
Lustrous Flower

A little light can change the way something ordinary is seen.

A flower in the dark, lit from behind — somewhere between what is there and what the light reveals.

Another experiment in light, form, and contrast.

stills.title: Steel Against the Sky
stills.quote: Some things become beautiful when you stop trying to look past them. Quietly standing above the rooftops.
stills.fullCaption:
Steel Against the Sky

Some things become beautiful when you stop trying to look past them.

Quietly standing above the rooftops — ordinary, familiar, yet somehow worth remembering.

stills.title: Misaligned
stills.quote: Not everything has to line up to feel intentional. An exercise in composition, balance, and controlled imperfection.
stills.fullCaption:
Misaligned

Not everything has to line up to feel intentional.

A mirror cube placed slightly off — shadows missing their mark, lines meeting where they shouldn't.

An exercise in composition, balance, and controlled imperfection.

Sometimes, misalignment is the composition.

stills.title: Sunlit Stillness
stills.quote: Some moments ask for nothing. No destination, no urgency — just a patch of grass, a little warmth, and the sun on your face.
stills.fullCaption:
Sunlit Stillness

Some moments ask for nothing.
No destination, no urgency — just a patch of grass, a little warmth, and the sun on your face.

Perhaps that's all a quiet afternoon needs.
